profile.headline: Software Engineer 🤖
profile.summary: Backend focused engineer with 9+ years of experience building high-scale distributed systems, financial services platforms, and blockchain integrated applications across Microsoft, Greenlight, and global enterprises. I specialize in Java, Node.js, microservices, event driven architecture, and cloud platforms (Azure/AWS) while driving delivery, reliability, and engineering excellence. At Microsoft, I’ve contributed to LSEG’s Digital Market Infrastructure, led large-scale environment migrations, built identity and wallet microservices, and delivered solutions spanning blockchain, supplychain visibility, and high traffic consumer experiences. I am also passionate about technical leadership mentoring engineers, leading cross functional projects, driving architectural standards, and improving onboarding, reliability, and developer workflows. My experience includes leading teams, owning critical services end to end, partnering with PM/design and shaping engineering culture in startup speed and enterprise environments.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
ISD – Engineering & Architecture Group
- Built and maintained our partner, LSEG, backend services for Digital Market Infrastructure integrating Java/Spring Boot microservices with blockchain digital-ledger systems.
- Enhanced enterprise identity & access management and delivered core account/wallet functionality supporting tokenized financial assets.
- Led Azure environment migration (dev → prod) for all of our team's services, improving reliability, deployment automation, and service readiness.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
Incubation Studio – CSCP (2022–2024)
- One of four engineers building blockchain POCs and MVPs for N-tier supply-chain visibility using Solidity, Node.js, and web3.js.
- Designed core smart contracts and shipped key backend APIs powering traceability and partner demo scenarios.
- Provisioned decentralized-ledger environments (Quorum, Tessera, IPFS) using Azure Bicep IaC.

WebXT – Windows 10 Widget (2021–2022)
- Shipped new UI layouts and interaction features improving user navigation by 4% and visual readiness by 3%.
- Implemented performance optimizations via lazy-loading and frontend refinements.
- Collaborated with design/PM to deliver user-facing features used across millions of Windows devices

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Led a team of four engineers building internal customer-service tools (React + Node).
- Reduced 40% of fraud-related tickets (1M+ users) by launching an identity-verification microservice using gRPC and event-driven patterns.
- Modernized the notification platform with an SNS/SQS event-driven design, improving reliability and throughput.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
- Improved site performance by reducing page load time ~400ms through native browser enhancements.
- Created a mock-service framework for Selenium testing, stabilizing UI automation.
- Reduced Jenkins regression runtime by 15% through test framework refactoring.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Developed, debugged and gave product support to provide cloud accounting solution as Salesforce ISV Developer
- Integrated customer's payment system with Sage Live to automate transactions using OAuth2.0 protocol and e-commerce API
- Created front-end integrating customer's shipping system with Sage Live using Lightning framework

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
- Developed RESTful API to be consumed on invoicing microservice with views in RubyonRails
      Gem: Byebug, Faker, FactoryGirl, Kaminari, Responders, Shoulda-matchers
- Integrated automated code reviewing tool into the department’s gitflow for all Rails projects
- Provisioned and maintained Linux server to host the code reviewing tool via SSH and Docker

positions.title: Web Dev. Intern Fall 2015
positions.description:
- Participated front-end development for Digital Data Consolidation project (CartoonNetwork)
- NCAA.com navigation bar prototypes with different frameworks (NCAA)
- Added Overtime 'OT' notion over courside box in NBA.com/teams (NBA Teamsites)

positions.title: LAMP Stack Developer Intern
positions.description:
The Cresca Group is business management consultancy helping online retailers by crafting a unique brand image, leveraging social media tools, improving market reach and conversion and developing back-end systems to simplify and streamline processes

- Built an e-commerce enterprise application with PHP and MySQL with 4 other developers
- Incorporated Scrum Agile development cycle
- Contributed and participated in Sprint planning, Sprint review, and Sprint retrorespective

projects.title: Enterprise Resource Planning E-Commerce Web Application
projects.description: Worked with a diverse team in an agile software development environment to design, build and test web applications integrated with an ERP system for rapidly growing E-Commerce business.
